findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-grok" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_catalog, get_catalog_item, create_agent_persona · Public sink: refine_model.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_catalog, get_catalog_item, create_agent_persona · Public sink: refine_model

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
